tuning_key.text: The credibility of what we know / Strains for authenticity
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The credibility of what we know / Strains for authenticity. Today you meet this strain at the boundary where assumption ends and the real begins. Hold that edge with clear precision; let conjecture fall away so only what is genuine remains to support your next step.

practice.title: Locate the Strain
practice.instruction: Scan your body for any tension that signals you are holding unverified assumptions—perhaps in your jaw, shoulders, or gut—and recognize this physical sensation as the boundary itself.

practice.title: Hold the Edge
practice.instruction: Without attempting to resolve or explain the uncertainty, simply maintain precise attention on the exact line where your knowledge ends and mystery begins.

practice.title: Sound the Echo
practice.instruction: Internally hear the echo phrase: "The strain is visible at the edge of what I thought I knew. I hold the boundary with clear precision, letting conjecture fall away. Only authenticity remains in this space."

archetype_tunings.The Steward: The boundary manifests at the edge of operational certainty, where logistics meet the unknown. As the strain for authenticity appears in your systems, conjecture falls away from resource allocation—only clear signal remains in the infrastructure you hold. The credibility of what you manage now aligns with what is actually real.
